name: luna
description: A monorepo starter template using moonrepo, bun, solid-start, and oxc.

scripts.setup: proto install && bun install --ignore-scripts && moon run api:build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.fix: bun run lint:fix && bun run format
scripts.clean: moon run :clean && moon clean --all && git clean -fdx -- .cache .moon/cache node_modules
